explanation: Port of SigabaNeoStd's colLaw_close with the family constants replaced by hypotheses: the mass of the sampler at x is the sum over syndromes v of D(x - d(v)); on the box |x_j| < tau m each term is within e^{+-theta} of rho(x); the tails of both laws outside the box (gaussZ_tail, cosetGauss_tail_M) pin the normalizing constant, and closeTo_of_ge concludes.
